business_summary: Shenzhen Hepalink Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. provides pharmaceutical products in Hong Kong, the United States, Europe, Mainland China, and internationally. It operates in four segments: Pharmaceutical preparations, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), and Others. The company offers pharmaceutical preparations products, such as enoxaparin sodium injection; API products, including heparin and enoxaparin sodium APIs. It also provides molecule biologics CDMO services, which include research and development, manufacturing, quality management, and program management services, as well as technical support services. In addition, the company develops apabetalone (RVX-208), a BET bromodomain protein inhibitor in Phase 3 trial to reduce major adverse cardiovascular events, as well as in Phase 2 trial for diabetic nephropathy and fatty disease; oregovomab, a monoclonal antibody in Phase 3 trial for ovarian cancer, as well as in Phase 2 for pancreatic cancer; tosatoxumab (AR-301), a fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody in Phase 3 trial for ventilator-associated pneumonia; and H1710, a heparanase inhibitor preparation for solid tumors. Further, it engages in property management, investment management and consulting, biopharmaceutical technology development and consulting, and equity and venture investment activities; provision of services on pharmaceutical related activities; and trading of medical and biopharmaceutical products. Shenzhen Hepalink Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shenzhen Hepalink Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Hepalink Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. in February 2017. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: Shenzhen Hepalink Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.는 홍콩, 미국, 유럽, 중국 본토 및 국제적으로 의약품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 의약품 제제, 활성 의약품 성분(API), 계약 개발 및 제조 조직(CDMO) 및 기타의 네 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 에녹사파린 나트륨 주사제와 같은 의약품 제제 제품을 제공합니다. 헤파린 및 에녹사파린 나트륨 API를 포함한 API 제품. 또한 연구 개발, 제조, 품질 관리, 프로그램 관리 서비스는 물론 기술 지원 서비스를 포함하는 분자 생물학 CDMO 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 주요 심혈관 사건을 줄이기 위한 3상 시험과 당뇨병성 신장병증 및 지방 질환에 대한 2상 시험에서 BET 브로모도메인 단백질 억제제인 ​​아파베탈론(RVX-208)을 개발하고 있습니다. 난소암에 대한 3상 시험과 췌장암에 대한 2상 시험에서 단일클론 항체인 oregovomab; 인공호흡기 관련 폐렴에 대한 3상 시험에서 완전 인간 IgG1 단일클론 항체인 토사톡수맙(AR-301); 및 고형분용 헤파라나제 억제제 제제인 H1710
